{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling potential errors
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print(crosstab)

# Compute conversion rates by channel
table = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference in conversion rates: email - paid_search
diff = table['email'] - table['paid_search']

# Print the results
print(f"Conversion rate (email): {table['email']:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {table['paid_search']:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.4f}")"}
